block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Frame pacing, lag spike resilience, and time debt absorption policy.
what_it_enables: Decoupled fixed simulation timestep (16.666ms) with render interpolation
Lag spike clamping preventing the simulation 'spiral of death' when host CPU stalls
Deterministic time debt absorption policy during severe OS hitch events
Frame-skipping thresholds for presentation without compromising simulation state
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocation during timing evaluation (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
Maximum allowed simulation delta strictly clamped to max_delta_clamp_ms
Maximum consecutive simulation steps per render frame strictly clamped to max_substeps
Simulation determinism strictly conserved across variable display refresh rates

fixed_timestep.description: Simulation updates at exactly 60 Hz regardless of physical render FPS.

lag_spike_defense.description: If a single frame takes > 100ms (OS hitch), clamp delta to 100ms (max 3 ticks) to prevent CPU freeze.

frame_skipping.description: If rendering falls behind simulation cadence, drop non-essential draw calls to recover display sync.

render_interpolation.description: Visuals smoothly blend between previous state and current state using sub-frame alpha.

tripwires.action: Clamp simulation ticks to max_substeps; emit telemetry warning
Truncate excess time debt to prevent time dilation
